title: Public School English Question Type Schema (Grades 1-9)
description: Standardized schema for K-9 public school English exam question types, decoupled from concrete quiz items and UI rendering widgets.

order.description: Display order within the (modality, skill) group.

modality.description: Top-level exam section: 笔试 (written) or 听力 (listening).

excelName.description: Original label from 公立1-9题型.xlsx.

uiTag.description: Original or planned interactive label (e.g. 消消乐, 答题卡, Recognition).

status.description: Whether the full showcase sample & rendered view are populated.

summary.description: Concise 1-2 sentence explanation of what this question type tests.

sampleImage.description: Relative path to the extracted high-res WebP sample image.

renderedSample.description: Optional structured content for crisp HTML/CSS high-definition paper rendering.

dataNote.description: Optional QA note from Excel ingestion (e.g., duplicate image flag).
